Citymaker.Recipe.TransitPlaza.Descriptio: Where bus, taxi, bike and car meet: bays on the kerb, shelters, bike racks, park & ride and a forecourt.
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.Name: Transit plaza
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.style.Tooltip: What the plaza is mainly for. Each type adds its own signature: car park, bike rows, taxi rank, centrepiece…
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.lotShare.Tooltip: Share of the area used for a park & ride car park at one end of the frontage. 0 = none.
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.taxis.Tooltip: Spaces in the taxi rank on the kerb lane.
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.dropOff.Tooltip: Kiss & ride spaces for a quick stop on the kerb lane.
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.bayLength.Tooltip: Length of each bus bay: 12 m for a standard bus, 18 m or more for articulated buses.
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.bollards.Tooltip: A row of bollards between the kerb lane and the plaza.
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.bikeRacks.Tooltip: Bike racks in rows near the kerb, five to a row.
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.bikeShelters.Tool: A roof over each row of bike racks.
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.bikeService.Toolt: A bike repair / service kiosk next to the racks.
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.signs.Tooltip: Wayfinding boards at the entrances and by the centre.
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.centrepiece.Toolt: A clock, statue or monument at the focal point opposite the kerb.
Citymaker.TransitPlaza.treeLayout.Toolti: Trees in a regular grid, in rows away from the street, or in islands with benches.
